rv.q: Claire Danes brings intelligence and considerable charm to Eliza Doolittle in this handsome revival of Shaw's 'Pygmalion,' though the production feels more respectful than revelatory.
How can you imagine two people sharing a life when they don’t even seem to share a stage?

cn.t: This handsome revival earns praise for Claire Danes' intelligent and charming Eliza, but critics find the production more respectful than revelatory, lacking fresh insight into Shaw's classic.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
